game.name: 勇者棋牌
game.genre: hidden-information turn-based cards and Nanjing mahjong

session.fairness: casual competitive; no real money or persistent currency
session.join_model: six-digit invite rooms or per-game server matchmaking; bots fill vacant seats
session.late_join: only token-bound original members during a match

trust_assumptions: Internet and desktop LAN use an independent server; clients never author cards or scores
Android LAN phone host and local practice worker are trusted; host can inspect authority state
topology.host_migration: server room owner transfers to another human; Android authority cannot migrate if host exits
risk_acceptance: Phone-hosted LAN is for trusted friends; use independent public backend for hidden-hand integrity
Public Internet play requires a deployed TLS server; no public service is bundled

authority.owner: match server (trusted worker for phone LAN/practice)
authority_validation: caller is active player or eligible claimant
request identifier has not already applied

authority.owner: match server (trusted worker for phone LAN/practice)
authority_validation: only own hand appears in snapshots
bots consume the same private/public snapshot as human clients

authority.owner: match server (trusted worker for phone LAN/practice)
authority_validation: rules calculate zero-sum scores and upgrades on authority

authority.owner: match server (trusted worker for phone LAN/practice)
authority_validation: only room owner configures or starts
all connected humans ready before start

simulation.clock: monotonic server revision and authority deadlines
simulation.tick_rate_basis: This game resolves discrete commands and does not require a continuous simulation tick.
simulation.prediction: Client may preview legal targets but never applies an outcome as final.
simulation.reconciliation: Server command result replaces pending client preview state by action identifier.
simulation.measurement_plan: Record command/reconnect timings in integration test output; test separate sockets under clean and delayed/duplicate conditions

replication.model: reliable commands plus canonical state snapshots
replication.interest_management: All public match state reaches members; private hand state reaches only its owner.
replication.hidden_state: The server never sends another player's private hand to a client.

transport.rationale: Broad target-browser support and reliable ordered turn commands fit this discrete simulation.
transport.fallback: Android LAN uses CampLan WebSocket bridge; explicit solo practice uses the identical Rooms service in a worker. No silent fallback for public matches.
transport.backpressure: Reuse bounded WebSocket framing: 16KiB messages, 32KiB receive buffer, 128KiB queued writes; overflow disconnects then authorized resnapshot

lifecycle.reconnect: Cryptographically random room-and-seat-bound token plus client id; reject takeover while connected; canonical private snapshot on resume
lifecycle.disconnect: Absent seats are controlled by bots; token reconnect within 30 seconds resumes the same seat. After grace the bot keeps the seat. Rooms without humans expire.
lifecycle.version_policy: Reject incompatible protocol versions before match membership or state mutation.

security.identity: Opaque crypto-random resume token, bound to room/seat/client id; guest display names are not identities
security.authorization: Check match membership, phase, ownership, and action permission for every message.
validation: physical ownership, legal combinations, phase and current revision
security.logging: Only aggregate room/peer counts and rejected command categories; never log tokens or hands

alerts: worker or socket failures shown to user

scenarios: independent clients see different private hands
invalid card ownership and claim priority
complete bot matches across four modes
landscape mobile viewport including maximum 33-card landlord hand
acceptance: No unauthorized private hand in captures
Duplicate or stale commands do not mutate cards/scores
Reconnect resumes original seat with current hand
Scores sum to zero and each physical card appears exactly once
Every mode reaches a legal round settlement

decisions.decision: Reuse current camp WebSocket and phone bridge with a distinct /chess-ws endpoint
decisions.reason: Preserves existing games and provides the same deployment for LAN and Internet
decisions.evidence: Existing games/liars/server.mjs and Android CampLan bridge

decisions.decision: Document Nanjing variant rather than claim exact Tencent parity
decisions.reason: Operator sources disagree on bases and bonuses; screenshot supplies toggles, not their definitions
decisions.evidence: User accepts common rules; gametea.com/news/201905/8708.html and static.laiyouxi.com/games/44.html
